description:
Problem: a pin-only diff can be classified as a trivial dependency bump while the wheel contains substantial SQL semantics. Derive old/new full fork/upstream identities from trusted base/head Git pins, fetch canonical source trees, stage full source delta and required runtime paths, verify actual relocated wheel bytes correspond to declared source, and classify/review that source, not PR-body claims. Reuse source-promotion invariants; no arbitrary cross-repo review framework.

Freshness gate: BenchBox #3942 replaced in-repo reviewer with hash-pinned Theseus 0.1.4. Inspect current package interfaces first. If the required hook is absent, third-repository write authorization and normal Theseus release/pin adoption are required; do not vendor a second reviewer or patch the installed package. Decision gates: invalid source/identity/hash, missing paths, incomplete staged coverage, oversized review => nonapproval with actionable reason; never exempt/trivial-success only from pin size. Reviewer must be independent, read-only and lack mutation credential.
